items.title: App Service plan
items.body: Setiap web app berjalan di App Service plan, yang menentukan OS (operating system), region, serta jumlah dan ukuran instance. Semua app di satu plan berbagi instance yang sama dan scale bersama; deployment slot dan backup juga memakai instance itu. Di tier dedicated, yang ditagih adalah setiap instance di plan, bukan setiap app.
keyPoints: App di satu plan berbagi dan scale bersama

items.prompt: Three apps in the same Standard plan with 2 instances are billed as 6 instances.
items.explanation: Salah. Di tier dedicated, yang ditagih adalah instance di plan. Ketiga app berbagi 2 instance yang sama.

items.prompt: You scale an App Service plan out from 2 to 4 instances. What happens to the three apps in the plan?
options: All three apps run on the 4 instances
Only the busiest app gets the new instances
Each app gets its own 4 instances
Nothing until each app is scaled separately
items.explanation: Semua app di satu plan berbagi instance yang sama, jadi scale plan berlaku untuk semuanya.

items.prompt: The App Service plan decides the region where its apps run.
items.explanation: Benar. Plan menentukan OS (operating system), region, serta jumlah dan ukuran instance.

items.title: Pricing tier
items.body: Free dan Shared memakai VM (virtual machine) bersama dan tidak bisa scale out; Shared sudah bisa custom domain. Basic memakai VM dedicated, scale manual sampai 3 instance, dan membuka TLS (Transport Layer Security) binding, managed certificate, backup, VNet (virtual network) integration, dan private endpoint. Standard menambah autoscale, sampai 10 instance, dan 5 deployment slot. Premium sampai 30 instance dan 20 slot. Isolated v2 menambah isolasi jaringan.

items.prompt: Sort each feature to the lowest tier that supports it.
items.explanation: Custom domain mulai Shared. Backup dan VNet (virtual network) integration mulai Basic. Autoscale dan deployment slot mulai Standard.

items.prompt: A web app needs deployment slots and rule-based autoscale at the lowest cost. Which tier should you choose?
options: Basic
Shared
Premium v3
Standard
items.explanation: Deployment slot dan autoscale mulai tersedia di Standard. Basic tidak punya keduanya, dan Premium lebih mahal dari yang diperlukan.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: An app runs in a Basic plan.

statements.text: It can scale out to 3 instances.
It can use a free App Service Managed Certificate.
It can add a staging deployment slot.

items.explanation: Basic bisa scale manual sampai 3 instance dan memakai managed certificate. Deployment slot butuh Standard ke atas.

items.title: Scale up vs scale out
items.body: Scale up berarti pindah ke pricing tier yang lebih tinggi untuk CPU (central processing unit), memori, disk, atau fitur tambahan seperti slot dan autoscale. Scale out berarti menambah jumlah instance yang menjalankan app. Batas scale out: Basic 3, Standard 10, dan Premium 30 instance. Free dan Shared tidak bisa scale out.

items.prompt: An app in the Basic tier needs deployment slots. Which kind of scaling gives it slots?
options: Scale out to 3 instances
Scale out to 10 instances
Add an autoscale rule
Scale up to Standard
items.explanation: Slot adalah fitur tier, jadi harus scale up. Menambah instance tidak menambah fitur.

items.prompt: A Standard App Service plan can scale out to 10 instances.
items.explanation: Benar. Basic sampai 3, Standard sampai 10, dan Premium sampai 30 instance.

items.title: Web app di dalam plan
items.body: Saat membuat web app, kamu memilih App Service plan yang sudah ada atau membuat plan baru; app itu lalu berjalan di semua instance plan tersebut. Karena semua app di satu plan scale bersama, pisahkan app yang butuh scaling berbeda ke plan sendiri.
keyPoints: App berjalan di semua instance plan
App dengan kebutuhan beda: plan terpisah

items.prompt: A busy public API (Application Programming Interface) and a small internal admin site are in the same plan. The API needs 8 instances, but the admin site doesn't. What should you do?
options: Move the admin site to its own plan
Scale out only the API inside the shared plan
Create a deployment slot for the admin site
Switch the plan to the Shared tier
items.explanation: App di satu plan scale bersama, jadi app dengan kebutuhan berbeda sebaiknya punya plan sendiri. Shared tidak bisa scale out.

items.prompt: Each web app always gets its own VM (virtual machine) instances, even when it shares a plan with other apps.
items.explanation: Salah. App di satu plan berbagi instance yang sama.

items.title: Tiga cara scale out
items.body: Ada tiga cara scale out App Service. Manual, dari Basic ke atas: kamu mengatur jumlah instance. Autoscale, dari Standard ke atas: aturan berbasis metrik seperti CPU (central processing unit) dan memori, atau berbasis jadwal. Automatic scaling, di Premium v2 sampai v4: App Service menambah instance sesuai trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) tanpa aturan, dengan instance prewarmed untuk mengurangi cold start.
keyPoints: Autoscale: Standard ke atas, aturan dan jadwal
Automatic scaling: Premium v2 ke atas, trafik HTTP

items.prompt: On weekdays from 08:00 to 18:00, the plan must run 5 instances. Outside those hours, 2 instances are enough. Configure the scale condition for office hours.
items.blade: plan-web > Scale out (App Service plan) > Custom autoscale > Add a scale condition

fields.label: Scale mode
choices: Scale to a specific instance count

answer.Scale mode: Scale to a specific instance count

items.explanation: Kondisi berbasis jadwal memakai jumlah instance tetap yang berulang setiap hari kerja. Default condition menangani jam lainnya dengan 2 instance.

items.prompt: An app in Premium v3 must scale on HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) traffic without writing any rules, and cold starts must be reduced. What should you use?
options: Autoscale with a CPU (central processing unit) rule
Manual scale out
A second deployment slot
Automatic scaling
items.explanation: Automatic scaling mengikuti trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) tanpa aturan, dan memakai instance prewarmed.

items.prompt: Rule-based autoscale is available in the Basic tier.
items.explanation: Salah. Basic hanya bisa scale manual. Autoscale mulai dari Standard.

items.prompt: Match each way to scale out to the lowest tier that offers it.
pairs: Automatic scaling on HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) traffic
items.explanation: Manual mulai Basic, autoscale mulai Standard, dan automatic scaling di Premium v2 sampai v4.

items.title: Memilih cara scale
items.body: Automatic scaling hanya melihat trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol). Kalau keputusan scaling harus berdasarkan CPU (central processing unit), memori, atau waktu, pakai autoscale. Di automatic scaling, App Service menyiapkan instance prewarmed, default-nya 1, dan setiap instance, termasuk yang prewarmed, ditagih per detik.

items.prompt: A batch app must add instances when memory use passes 80%. Which option fits?
options: Automatic scaling
Manual scale out every morning
A custom domain
Autoscale with a memory rule
items.explanation: Automatic scaling hanya berdasarkan trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol). Scaling berbasis memori butuh autoscale.

items.prompt: Automatic scaling keeps one prewarmed instance by default.
items.explanation: Benar. Instance prewarmed default-nya 1, untuk mengurangi cold start.

items.title: Custom domain
items.body: Custom domain butuh plan berbayar, bukan Free (F1). Di penyedia domain, buat record pemetaan: A record untuk root domain seperti contoso.com, atau CNAME (canonical name) untuk subdomain seperti www. CNAME dipilih untuk subdomain karena IP (Internet Protocol) app bisa berubah, sedangkan default hostname-nya tetap.

items.prompt: You map the root domain contoso.com to a web app. Which mapping record should you create?
options: A CNAME (canonical name) record
An A record
An MX (mail exchange) record
An NS (name server) record
items.explanation: Root domain memakai A record; CNAME (canonical name) tidak dipakai di root domain. MX (mail exchange) untuk email, dan NS (name server) untuk delegasi.

items.prompt: You can add a custom domain to an app in the Free (F1) tier.
items.explanation: Salah. Custom domain butuh plan berbayar; Free tidak bisa.

items.title: Verifikasi domain
items.body: Selain record pemetaan, portal meminta record TXT (text) bernama asuid (asuid.www untuk subdomain www) berisi domain verification ID (identifier). Record ini membuktikan domain milikmu. Untuk subdomain dengan CNAME (canonical name), TXT asuid tidak wajib, tapi sangat disarankan untuk mencegah subdomain takeover oleh app App Service lain.

items.prompt: You map www.contoso.com with a CNAME (canonical name). Which other record does App Service ask for, to verify ownership?
options: An A record named www
A CNAME record named asuid
A TXT (text) record named asuid.www with the verification ID (identifier)
An MX (mail exchange) record named www
items.explanation: Verifikasi memakai TXT (text) asuid.www berisi domain verification ID (identifier).

items.prompt: What does the asuid TXT (text) record prove to App Service?
options: That the app has a managed certificate
That you own the custom domain
That the domain uses Azure DNS (Domain Name System)
That the app is in the Basic tier
items.explanation: Record TXT (text) asuid berisi domain verification ID (identifier), bukti bahwa domain itu milikmu.

items.prompt: For a subdomain mapped with a CNAME (canonical name), the asuid TXT (text) record is strongly recommended to prevent subdomain takeover.
items.explanation: Benar. Record itu tidak wajib untuk CNAME (canonical name), tapi sangat disarankan demi keamanan.

items.title: Sertifikat TLS
items.body: Untuk mengamankan custom domain dengan HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure), App Service Managed Certificate adalah pilihan gratis: dibuat dan diperbarui otomatis oleh App Service. Sertifikat ini butuh tier Basic ke atas dan tidak mendukung wildcard, misalnya *.contoso.com. Untuk wildcard, pakai sertifikat lain, misalnya App Service certificate atau sertifikat yang kamu impor.

items.prompt: An app in the Shared tier has the custom domain www.contoso.com. You want a free managed certificate. What must you do first?
options: Change the CNAME (canonical name) to an A record
Scale up to Basic or higher
Delete the asuid TXT (text) record
Create a deployment slot
items.explanation: Managed certificate butuh tier Basic ke atas.

items.prompt: An App Service Managed Certificate can cover *.contoso.com.
items.explanation: Salah. Managed certificate tidak mendukung wildcard.

items.prompt: Secure www.contoso.com with HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) on an app in the Basic tier. Put the steps in order.
items: Add the CNAME (canonical name) and the asuid.www TXT (text) record at the domain provider
Add the custom domain to the app
Create a free App Service Managed Certificate and bind it
items.explanation: Record DNS (Domain Name System) dibuat dulu supaya domain bisa diverifikasi, lalu domain ditambahkan, baru sertifikat dibuat dan di-bind.

items.title: Backup App Service
items.body: Backup dan restore tersedia di Basic, Standard, Premium, dan Isolated. Di Basic, hanya slot production yang bisa di-backup. Automatic backup dibuat berkala tanpa storage account dan disimpan 30 hari. Custom backup butuh storage account, bisa manual atau terjadwal, dan maksimal 10 GB (gigabyte).

items.prompt: You want scheduled custom backups of a web app. What must you provide?
options: A storage account
A deployment slot
A VNet (virtual network) integration subnet
A managed certificate
items.explanation: Custom backup butuh storage account. Automatic backup tidak.

items.prompt: In the Basic tier, you can back up a staging slot.
items.explanation: Salah. Di Basic hanya slot production yang bisa di-backup dan di-restore.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A web app runs in the Standard tier.

statements.text: Automatic backups are made without a storage account.
Automatic backups are kept for 90 days.
A custom backup can be up to 10 GB (gigabyte).

items.explanation: Automatic backup tidak butuh storage account dan disimpan 30 hari. Custom backup maksimal 10 GB (gigabyte).

items.title: Trafik keluar vs trafik masuk
items.body: VNet (virtual network) integration, dari Basic ke atas, hanya untuk trafik keluar: app bisa menjangkau VM (virtual machine) atau database di virtual network. Fitur ini tidak memberi akses masuk. Untuk trafik masuk secara privat, pakai private endpoint, yang memberi app alamat IP (Internet Protocol) privat di virtual network.

items.prompt: Sort each need to the feature that handles it.

items.text: The app calls a database on a private IP (Internet Protocol) in the VNet
The app reaches a VM (virtual machine) in a peered VNet
Users in the VNet open the app on a private IP
On-premises clients reach the app through a VPN (virtual private network) into the VNet

items.explanation: Panggilan dari app ke virtual network adalah trafik keluar (VNet (virtual network) integration). Klien yang mengakses app secara privat adalah trafik masuk (private endpoint).

items.prompt: You enabled VNet (virtual network) integration, but VMs (virtual machines) in the VNet still can't reach the app on a private IP (Internet Protocol). Why?
options: VNet integration handles only outbound traffic; inbound needs a private endpoint
VNet integration needs the Premium tier
The subnet must be /8
Access restrictions block all VNets by default
items.explanation: VNet (virtual network) integration hanya untuk trafik keluar dari app. Akses masuk privat butuh private endpoint.

items.prompt: VNet (virtual network) integration requires at least the Basic tier.
items.explanation: Benar. VNet (virtual network) integration butuh tier dedicated, Basic ke atas.

items.title: Access restriction
items.body: Access restriction membatasi trafik masuk ke app dengan daftar allow dan deny berprioritas, berdasarkan IP (Internet Protocol), subnet, atau service tag. Aturan dengan angka prioritas terkecil dicek lebih dulu. Begitu ada satu aturan, ada deny all implisit di akhir, jadi sumber yang tidak cocok ditolak dengan HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) 403.

items.prompt: You add one access restriction rule that allows 203.0.113.0/24. What happens to requests from other addresses?
options: They are denied with HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) 403
They are allowed, because only one rule exists
They are sent to a staging slot
They are allowed until you add a deny rule
items.explanation: Begitu ada satu aturan, ada deny all implisit di akhir, jadi alamat lain ditolak dengan 403.

items.prompt: Access restriction rules with the lowest priority number are evaluated first.
items.explanation: Benar. Aturan dicek mulai dari angka prioritas terkecil.

items.title: Deployment slot
items.body: Deployment slot adalah app yang berjalan dengan host name sendiri, misalnya staging, dan butuh tier Standard, Premium, atau Isolated. Standard mendukung sampai 5 slot, Premium dan Isolated sampai 20, tanpa biaya tambahan. App dengan lebih dari 5 slot tidak bisa diturunkan ke Standard.

items.prompt: Deployment slots cost extra on top of the App Service plan.
items.explanation: Salah. Slot tidak dikenai biaya tambahan; slot berjalan di instance plan yang sama.

items.prompt: An app in Premium v3 uses 8 deployment slots. Can you scale the plan down to Standard?
options: Yes, slots move to a new plan automatically
No, Standard supports only 5 slots
Yes, but only 5 slots keep running
No, slots require Isolated
items.explanation: Tier tujuan harus mendukung jumlah slot yang sudah dipakai. Standard hanya 5.

items.prompt: What is the lowest tier that supports deployment slots?
options: Basic
Shared
Standard
Premium v2
items.explanation: Deployment slot butuh Standard, Premium, atau Isolated.

items.title: Swap
items.body: Swap menukar isi dan konfigurasi dua slot, biasanya staging ke production. Slot sumber di-warm up dulu, jadi tidak ada downtime. Kalau versi baru bermasalah, swap yang sama bisa diulang untuk mengembalikan versi lama. Swap with preview berhenti setelah langkah pertama, supaya slot sumber bisa dicek dengan setting production sebelum swap diselesaikan.

items.prompt: Right after a swap from staging to production, the new version shows errors. What is the fastest way back?
options: Restore the app from a backup
Redeploy the old code to production
Scale out production
Swap the same two slots again
items.explanation: Setelah swap, versi lama ada di staging, jadi swap ulang langsung mengembalikannya.

items.prompt: With swap with preview, you can check the source slot with the production settings before the swap completes.
items.explanation: Benar. Swap berhenti setelah langkah pertama supaya kamu bisa memeriksa hasilnya.

items.prompt: During a swap, the production slot stays online while the source slot warms up.
items.explanation: Benar. Semua persiapan terjadi di slot sumber, jadi production tetap melayani tanpa downtime.

items.title: Slot setting
items.body: App setting dan connection string ikut di-swap bersama kode, kecuali ditandai sebagai deployment slot setting. Setting yang ditandai tetap di slot-nya. Beberapa hal selalu tetap di slot: custom domain, pengaturan TLS (Transport Layer Security), scale setting, managed identity, dan VNet (virtual network) integration. Jadi tandai connection string database staging sebagai slot setting.
keyPoints: Ikut swap, kecuali ditandai slot setting

items.prompt: After swapping staging into production, production now writes to the staging database. What should you have done?

scene.title: webapp-contoso/staging > Configuration > Connection strings
scene.message: DB_CONNECTION = staging-db. Deployment slot setting: unchecked.

options: Use swap with preview only
Mark DB_CONNECTION as a deployment slot setting in both slots
Scale out the staging slot
Add a custom domain to staging
items.explanation: Connection string yang tidak ditandai slot setting ikut pindah saat swap. Menandainya membuat nilai itu tetap di slot masing-masing.

items.prompt: Which two stay with their slot during a swap, without extra configuration? Choose two.
options: Scale settings
The app code
An unmarked app setting
Custom domain names
items.explanation: Custom domain dan scale setting selalu tetap di slot. Kode dan app setting yang tidak ditandai ikut di-swap.

items.title: Membuat web app
items.body: Saat membuat web app, kamu memilih Publish (Code atau Container), runtime stack, OS (operating system) Linux atau Windows, region, dan App Service plan. Region app mengikuti plan-nya, dan region plan tidak bisa diubah; untuk region lain, clone app ke plan di region itu. App hanya bisa dipindah ke plan lain di resource group, region, dan jenis OS yang sama. Di Azure CLI (command-line interface), buat plan dengan az appservice plan create, lalu app dengan az webapp create --plan.
keyPoints: Pindah plan: resource group, region, OS sama

items.prompt: A company will deploy its app as a container image instead of source code. Which setting on the Basics tab of Create Web App should you change?
options: Runtime stack
Publish
Pricing plan
Region
items.explanation: Publish menentukan apakah app di-deploy sebagai Code atau Container. Runtime stack dipilih untuk app berbentuk kode.

items.prompt: At a company, app1 runs in plan-a. Based on the table, to which plans can you move app1?
options: plan-b and plan-e
plan-d and plan-e
plan-e only
plan-c, plan-d, and plan-e
items.explanation: App hanya bisa dipindah ke plan di resource group, region, dan jenis OS (operating system) yang sama. plan-b berbeda OS, plan-c berbeda region, dan plan-d berbeda resource group.

items.prompt: app1 runs in an App Service plan in West Europe. A company must run app1 in East US. What should the company do?
options: Change the region of the current plan to East US
Move app1 to a resource group that is in East US
Clone app1 to a plan in East US
Scale up the plan to Premium, which allows a region change
items.explanation: Region app mengikuti plan-nya, dan region plan tidak bisa diubah. Clone app membuat salinan app di plan di region mana pun.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to create app2 in the Windows plan plan-a, which is in rg-web in West Europe.

statements.text: app2 will run in West Europe.
Contoso can later move app2 to a Linux plan in rg-web in West Europe.
Contoso can later change the region of plan-a.

items.explanation: Region app mengikuti plan-nya, dan region plan tidak bisa diubah. Pindah ke plan dengan OS (operating system) lain tidak didukung.

items.title: Sertifikat dan pengaturan TLS
items.body: Sertifikat custom domain bisa berupa App Service Managed Certificate gratis, App Service certificate, sertifikat Azure Key Vault, atau sertifikat privat yang di-upload; semuanya butuh tier Basic ke atas. Sertifikat privat harus berupa file PFX (Personal Information Exchange) berpassword dengan rantai sertifikat lengkap. SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) bisa banyak binding di satu IP (Internet Protocol) bersama; IP based SSL hanya satu, dengan IP dedicated, di Standard ke atas. Minimum TLS (Transport Layer Security) default-nya 1.2 dan bisa dinaikkan ke 1.3. HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) Only mengalihkan HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) ke HTTPS.
keyPoints: Sertifikat privat: PFX berpassword, rantai lengkap
SNI SSL: banyak domain, satu IP
IP based SSL: IP dedicated, Standard ke atas
items.trap: IP based SSL memberi app alamat IP baru. Kalau domain memakai A record, record itu harus diperbarui ke IP dedicated yang baru.

items.prompt: A company has a certificate for www.contoso.com from a non-Microsoft provider, exported as a PFX (Personal Information Exchange) file. What must the file meet before the company uploads it to App Service?
options: It has no password, so that App Service can read it
It includes only the server certificate, without intermediate certificates
It is password-protected and includes the whole certificate chain
It is issued by Microsoft, because other providers are not supported
items.explanation: Sertifikat privat harus berupa file PFX (Personal Information Exchange) yang dilindungi password dan berisi semua intermediate certificate dan root certificate. Sertifikat dari penyedia lain boleh di-upload.

items.prompt: A company must secure www.contoso.com and shop.contoso.com on one app, which uses the shared IP (Internet Protocol) address of App Service. Which TLS (Transport Layer Security)/SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) type should you choose for the bindings?
options: IP based SSL, with one binding for each domain
SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL
IP based SSL for one domain, and no binding for the other
No binding, because a managed certificate binds itself
items.explanation: SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) bisa dibuat banyak untuk beberapa domain di satu alamat IP (Internet Protocol). IP based SSL hanya bisa satu binding per app, dengan IP dedicated.

items.prompt: IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) bindings are supported in the Basic tier.
items.explanation: IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) butuh tier Standard ke atas. SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL sudah bisa di Basic.

items.prompt: A company's security team requires that a web app rejects TLS (Transport Layer Security) 1.2 and older, and that HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) requests are sent on to HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure). What should you configure?
options: Minimum Inbound TLS Version 1.2, and HTTPS Only on
Minimum Inbound TLS Version 1.3, and HTTPS Only on
An IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) binding, and HTTPS Only off
A managed certificate, which sets both automatically
items.explanation: Minimum TLS (Transport Layer Security) default-nya 1.2, jadi untuk menolak TLS 1.2 naikkan ke 1.3. HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) Only mengalihkan semua trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) ke HTTPS.

items.title: Restore dan detail backup
items.body: Backup bisa di-restore dengan menimpa app yang ada, atau ke app atau slot baru. Selama restore, app atau slot tujuan dihentikan, jadi untuk production restore dulu ke deployment slot lalu swap. Automatic backup dibuat setiap jam, sampai 30 GB (gigabyte), disimpan 30 hari, dan tidak bisa diatur. Custom backup butuh storage account dengan otorisasi SAS (shared access signature), bisa dijadwalkan paling sering setiap 2 jam, retensinya sampai tanpa batas, dan mendukung partial backup.
keyPoints: Production: restore ke slot, lalu swap
Custom: storage account, retensi bisa tanpa batas
items.trap: Materi lama sering menyebut opsi Include database di custom backup. Opsi itu sudah dihapus untuk konfigurasi baru, jadi database dilindungi dengan backup bawaan layanan database.

items.prompt: A company must restore a production app from a backup with the least downtime. What should the company do?
options: Restore over the production app directly, during business hours
Restore to a deployment slot, and then swap it into production
Restore to a new storage account, and then point the app to it
Delete the app, and then restore to a new app with the same name
items.explanation: Selama restore, app atau slot tujuan dihentikan. Untuk production, restore dulu ke deployment slot, lalu swap ke production tanpa downtime.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A company's app contoso-web runs in the Standard tier and uses automatic backups only.

statements.text: A backup is made every hour.
The company can change the backup frequency to every 6 hours.
Each backup is kept for 30 days.

items.explanation: Automatic backup dibuat setiap jam, frekuensinya tidak bisa diatur, dan disimpan 30 hari. Untuk jadwal sendiri, pakai custom backup.

items.prompt: A company wants backups of its web app that are kept indefinitely and that leave out the folder /logs. What should the company use?
options: Automatic backups with a longer retention
Automatic backups with a filter for /logs
A deployment slot that holds the old version
A custom backup to a storage account
items.explanation: Automatic backup disimpan 30 hari dan tidak mendukung partial backup. Custom backup ke storage account bisa disimpan tanpa batas dan mendukung partial backup.

items.prompt: A company runs three apps in one Standard App Service plan with 3 instances. What does the company pay for in compute?
options: 3 instances of the plan
9 instances, 3 for each app
3 apps, each at the price of one instance
Only the instances that the busiest app uses
items.explanation: Di tier dedicated, yang ditagih adalah setiap instance VM (virtual machine) di plan, bukan setiap app. Ketiga app berbagi 3 instance yang sama.

items.prompt: A company needs a web app with a custom domain, a free managed certificate, and up to 3 instances, at the lowest cost. Which tier should the company choose?
options: Shared
Free
Basic
Standard
items.explanation: Custom domain butuh Shared ke atas, managed certificate butuh Basic ke atas, dan Basic bisa scale out sampai 3 instance. Standard juga bisa, tapi lebih mahal.

items.prompt: A company must run a new app on Linux. Its only App Service plan, plan-win, runs Windows. What should the company do?
options: Create the app in plan-win, and choose Linux on the Basics tab
Change the OS (operating system) of plan-win to Linux
Create the app in plan-win, and move it to a Linux plan later
Create a Linux App Service plan, and create the app in it
items.explanation: Plan menentukan OS (operating system) untuk semua app di dalamnya, dan app tidak bisa dipindah ke plan dengan OS lain. Buat plan Linux, lalu buat app di plan itu.

items.prompt: A company must create the web app contoso-api in rg-web by using the Azure CLI (command-line interface). rg-web has no App Service plan yet. Which two commands should the company run? Choose two.
options: az appservice plan create
az webapp create with --plan
az webapp deployment slot create
az storage account create
items.explanation: Plan dibuat dulu dengan az appservice plan create, lalu app dibuat di plan itu dengan az webapp create --plan.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso wants HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) for www.contoso.com and *.contoso.com on an app in the Standard tier.

statements.text: Contoso can import a wildcard certificate for *.contoso.com from Azure Key Vault.
A free App Service Managed Certificate can secure *.contoso.com.
The app can have only one SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) binding.

items.explanation: Sertifikat, termasuk wildcard, bisa di-import dari Azure Key Vault. Managed certificate gratis tidak mendukung wildcard. SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) bisa dibuat banyak; yang hanya satu adalah IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL.

items.prompt: A company changes the TLS (Transport Layer Security) binding of www.contoso.com from SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) to IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL. www.contoso.com is mapped with an A record. What must the company do next?
options: Nothing, because the IP address of the app stays the same
Delete the asuid TXT (text) record, because IP based SSL does not need it
Update the A record to the new dedicated IP address of the app
Scale the plan down to the Basic tier
items.explanation: IP (Internet Protocol) based SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) membuat alamat IP dedicated baru untuk app. Karena domain memakai A record, record itu harus diarahkan ke IP baru.

items.prompt: A company maps shop.contoso.com to its web app by using a CNAME (canonical name) record. The company must prevent another App Service app from taking over the subdomain. What else should the company create?
options: A TXT (text) record named asuid.shop with the verification ID (identifier)
An A record named shop that holds the IP (Internet Protocol) address of the app
A TXT record named shop that holds the name of the app
A CNAME record named asuid that points to the app
items.explanation: Untuk subdomain dengan CNAME (canonical name), record TXT (text) asuid.<subdomain> berisi domain verification ID (identifier) tidak wajib, tapi sangat disarankan untuk mencegah subdomain takeover.

items.prompt: A company maps the root domain contoso.com to its web app. Which records should the company create at the domain provider?
options: A CNAME (canonical name) record for @ that points to the default host name of the web app
An A record for www only, because the root domain then follows the www record automatically
An A record for @, and a TXT (text) record asuid with the verification ID (identifier)
An MX (mail exchange) record for @, and a TXT record named asuid.www
items.explanation: Root domain dipetakan dengan A record, ditambah TXT (text) asuid berisi domain verification ID (identifier). CNAME (canonical name) dipakai untuk subdomain seperti www.

items.prompt: A company's app runs in the Free (F1) tier. The company must use the custom domain www.contoso.com at the lowest cost. What should the company do first?
options: Scale up the plan to the Shared tier or higher
Add the domain in the Free tier, because custom domains are free
Create an App Service Managed Certificate
Move the app to a plan in another region
items.explanation: Custom domain butuh plan berbayar, bukan Free (F1). Shared adalah tier berbayar terendah yang mendukungnya.

items.prompt: A company configures a new custom backup for a web app that uses an Azure SQL (Structured Query Language) database. The database must also be protected. What should you recommend?
options: Select Include database in the new custom backup
Use the backup features of Azure SQL Database itself
Use automatic backups, which include the linked database
Add the connection string as a deployment slot setting
items.explanation: Opsi menyertakan linked database sudah dihapus dari konfigurasi custom backup baru, dan automatic backup tidak pernah mem-backup linked database. Pakai backup bawaan Azure SQL (Structured Query Language) Database.

items.prompt: A company configures a custom backup of its web app to the storage account stbackup, and wants App Service to reach the account only through a managed identity. Why can't this work?
options: The storage account must be in a different region from the app for backups
App Service backup needs SAS (shared access signature) authorization
Custom backups to a storage account are available only in the Premium tier
The storage account must hold only Premium file shares
items.explanation: Custom backup butuh storage account yang mendukung otorisasi SAS (shared access signature). Autentikasi managed identity ke storage account tidak didukung untuk backup dan restore App Service.

items.prompt: A company configured the access restrictions of its web app as shown. A user at 203.0.113.50 opens the app. What happens?
options: The request is denied by the rule at priority 200, because it is more specific
The request is denied with HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) 403 by the implicit deny
The request is allowed, because App Service skips /32 rules
The request is allowed by the rule at priority 100
items.explanation: Aturan diproses dari angka prioritas terkecil, dan aturan pertama yang cocok yang berlaku. 203.0.113.50 cocok dengan aturan 100, jadi diizinkan.

items.prompt: A company's web app must call an API (Application Programming Interface) on a virtual machine with a private IP (Internet Protocol) address in VNet1. Users in VNet1 must also open the app on a private IP address. What should the company configure?
options: A private endpoint only, because it handles traffic in both directions
VNet (virtual network) integration only, because it handles traffic in both directions
Access restrictions that allow VNet1, for both directions
VNet integration for the calls, and a private endpoint for the users
items.explanation: VNet (virtual network) integration hanya untuk trafik keluar dari app ke VNet, dan private endpoint hanya untuk trafik masuk ke app. Kebutuhan dua arah butuh keduanya.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to add one access restriction rule to contoso-web that allows 198.51.100.0/24 at priority 100.

statements.text: A request from 203.0.113.9 is allowed, because no rule denies it.
A request from 203.0.113.9 gets HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) 403.

items.explanation: Begitu ada satu aturan, ada deny all implisit di akhir, dan request yang ditolak mendapat HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) 403.

items.prompt: A company's staging slot has the app setting FEATURE_X=on, which must never move to production during a swap. What should the company do?
options: Mark FEATURE_X as a deployment slot setting
Use swap with preview for every swap
Add FEATURE_X as a connection string
Turn FEATURE_X off in production after each swap
items.explanation: App setting dan connection string ikut di-swap, kecuali ditandai sebagai deployment slot setting. Swap with preview hanya menunda langkah kedua.

facts.statement: Setiap app App Service berjalan di App Service plan, yang menentukan OS (operating system), region, jumlah dan ukuran instance VM (virtual machine), serta pricing tier.
Semua app di satu App Service plan berbagi instance VM (virtual machine) yang sama dan scale bersama; deployment slot, backup, dan WebJobs juga memakai instance itu.

Free dan Shared menjalankan app di VM (virtual machine) bersama dengan pelanggan lain dan tidak bisa scale out. Basic, Standard, dan Premium memakai VM dedicated. Isolated v2 menambah isolasi jaringan.
Di tier dedicated, yang ditagih adalah setiap instance VM (virtual machine) di plan, bukan setiap app.

Scale up berarti mengganti pricing tier untuk mendapat CPU (central processing unit), memori, disk, atau fitur lebih. Scale out berarti menambah jumlah instance: Basic sampai 3, Standard sampai 10, dan Premium sampai 30.

Custom domain butuh tier berbayar (Shared ke atas). TLS (Transport Layer Security) binding untuk custom domain, managed certificate, backup, VNet (virtual network) integration, dan private endpoint butuh Basic ke atas. Autoscale butuh Standard ke atas. Deployment slot: Standard 5, Premium dan Isolated 20.
Tiga cara scale out App Service: manual (Basic ke atas), autoscale berbasis aturan metrik dan jadwal (Standard ke atas), dan automatic scaling berbasis trafik HTTP (Premium v2 sampai v4).

Automatic scaling menambah instance berdasarkan trafik HTTP tanpa aturan atau jadwal, dengan instance prewarmed (default 1) untuk mengurangi cold start. Untuk scaling berbasis CPU (central processing unit), memori, atau waktu, pakai autoscale.
Custom domain butuh App Service plan berbayar, bukan Free (F1).

Untuk custom domain, buat record DNS (Domain Name System) di penyedia domain: A record untuk root domain seperti contoso.com, atau CNAME untuk subdomain seperti www. Tambahkan juga TXT asuid (asuid.www untuk subdomain) berisi domain verification ID.
Record TXT asuid untuk subdomain dengan CNAME tidak wajib, tapi sangat disarankan untuk mencegah subdomain takeover oleh app App Service lain.
App Service Managed Certificate gratis, diperbarui otomatis, dan butuh tier Basic ke atas. Sertifikat ini tidak mendukung wildcard.
Backup dan restore didukung di Basic, Standard, Premium, dan Isolated. Di Basic, hanya slot production yang bisa di-backup dan di-restore.
Automatic backup dibuat berkala tanpa storage account dan disimpan 30 hari. Custom backup butuh storage account, bisa manual atau terjadwal, dan maksimal 10 GB (gigabyte).
VNet (virtual network) integration butuh tier dedicated (Basic ke atas) dan hanya menangani trafik keluar dari app ke virtual network. Fitur ini memakai subnet khusus.
Private endpoint memberi app alamat IP privat di virtual network, dan hanya untuk trafik masuk ke app.

Access restriction adalah daftar allow dan deny berprioritas untuk trafik masuk, berdasarkan IP (Internet Protocol), subnet, atau service tag. Begitu ada satu aturan, ada deny all implisit di akhir, dan request yang ditolak mendapat HTTP 403.
Deployment slot adalah app yang berjalan dengan host name sendiri, dan butuh tier Standard, Premium, atau Isolated. Standard mendukung sampai 5 slot, dan slot tidak dikenai biaya tambahan.
Swap menukar isi dan konfigurasi dua slot. Slot sumber di-warm up dulu, jadi tidak ada downtime, dan swap yang sama bisa diulang untuk kembali ke versi sebelumnya.

App setting dan connection string ikut di-swap, kecuali ditandai sebagai deployment slot setting. Custom domain, TLS (Transport Layer Security) setting, scale setting, managed identity, dan VNet (virtual network) integration tetap di slot-nya.
Swap with preview berhenti setelah langkah pertama, supaya slot sumber bisa dicek dengan setting slot tujuan sebelum swap diselesaikan.
App dengan lebih dari 5 slot tidak bisa diturunkan ke tier Standard, karena Standard hanya mendukung 5 slot.

Saat membuat web app di portal, kamu memilih Publish (Code atau Container), runtime stack, OS (operating system) Linux atau Windows, region, dan App Service plan. Di Azure CLI (command-line interface), plan dibuat dengan az appservice plan create, lalu app dengan az webapp create --plan.

App bisa dipindah ke App Service plan lain hanya kalau kedua plan ada di resource group, region, dan jenis OS (operating system) yang sama. Pindah jenis, misalnya dari Windows ke Linux, tidak didukung.
Region app sama dengan region App Service plan-nya, dan region plan tidak bisa diubah. Untuk menjalankan app di region lain, salah satu caranya adalah clone app ke plan di region itu.

Sertifikat untuk custom domain di App Service bisa berupa App Service Managed Certificate yang gratis, App Service certificate yang di-import, sertifikat dari Azure Key Vault, atau sertifikat privat yang di-upload. Semuanya butuh tier Basic, Standard, Premium, atau Isolated.

Sertifikat privat yang di-upload atau di-import harus berupa file PFX (Personal Information Exchange) yang dilindungi password dan berisi semua intermediate certificate dan root certificate. Untuk TLS (Transport Layer Security) binding, sertifikat juga harus untuk server authentication dan ditandatangani certificate authority tepercaya.

TLS (Transport Layer Security) binding ada dua jenis. SNI (Server Name Indication) SSL bisa dibuat banyak, untuk beberapa domain di satu alamat IP (Internet Protocol) bersama. IP based SSL hanya satu binding dengan IP publik dedicated, dan butuh tier Standard ke atas; setelah itu A record domain harus diarahkan ke IP dedicated yang baru.
Minimum TLS (Transport Layer Security) version untuk app baru default-nya TLS 1.2, dan bisa dinaikkan ke TLS 1.3 untuk semua request masuk. TLS 1.0 dan 1.1 tidak lagi dianggap aman.
Pengaturan HTTPS Only mengalihkan semua trafik HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) ke HTTPS.

Backup bisa di-restore dengan menimpa app yang ada, atau ke app baru atau slot baru. Selama restore, app atau slot tujuan dihentikan, jadi untuk app production, restore dulu ke deployment slot lalu swap.

Automatic backup dibuat setiap jam (tidak bisa diatur), sampai 30 GB (gigabyte), disimpan 30 hari, dan tidak mem-backup linked database. Custom backup bisa dijadwalkan paling sering setiap 2 jam (maksimal 12 backup per hari), retensinya 0 sampai 30 hari atau tanpa batas, dan mendukung partial backup.

Custom backup butuh storage account di subscription yang sama yang mendukung otorisasi SAS (shared access signature). Autentikasi managed identity ke storage account tidak didukung untuk backup dan restore App Service.

Opsi menyertakan linked database di konfigurasi custom backup baru sudah dihapus (MySQL dan PostgreSQL sejak November 2025, Azure SQL sejak April 2026), dan mulai 31 Maret 2028 linked database tidak di-backup sama sekali. Pakai backup bawaan layanan database.
